Author: Johnneylee Jack Rollins
Name: Ghostty
Description: Developer preview. A Quake-style dropdown, floating windows and terminals pinned in the world, connected to shells on your own machine through ghostty-agent, or to local ConPTY on Windows. /term to toggle. Works with or without Umbra; with Umbra, the Ghostty toolbar widget shows its status and a popup terminal. Target-platform and in-game verification are still in progress.
